name: Alliances Political
overview: Scripture clearly warns against forming political alliances with idolaters, emphasizing that such covenants lead to spiritual compromise and sin. The Israelites are instructed not to make agreements with the inhabitants of the land or their gods, as these alliances become snares that draw God's people away from exclusive worship of the LORD. Instead, they are commanded to destroy the altars and images of false gods to maintain purity in their worship, recognizing that God is a jealous God who demands undivided loyalty.
